limitations: Hashes record repository bytes inspected during packaging; hosted code is not included or executed.
Installed validation checks local client bytes and this retained review declaration.
Hosted deployment, live controls and model delivery require separate acceptance evidence.

security_controls.control: Discovery returns only the catalogue generated from the exact packaged services. A named tool, prompt or resource request starts its registered local owner and forwards its JSON-RPC payload and response unchanged. The transport does not inspect intent, add case data, send network requests or replay failed calls. Existing service-specific model and external data boundaries still apply. The legacy Codex entry resolves its relative launcher against the plugin working directory. Portable Codex and Cowork packaging project their respective supported root placeholders without adding filesystem authority. Lucia exposes chat and panel entries backed by the same Studio Archive runtime. Its MCP and CLI entries accept the three Archive workflows in components.json; accounting sample checks and Vera-only report receipt verification are excluded. The transport uses the same local Archive worker and adds no external recipient. Useful product workflow controls are owned by the registered native report, firm-method or matter-review apps. Redundant metadata renderers and resources are not advertised by Lucia’s review-engine adapter; validation, model-policy checks and explicit save/apply tools remain available. No retired renderer grants a second app route.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject unknown targets and return worker failures without replaying possible side effects.

security_controls.control: Concurrent first requests share a worker. Used services retain their review state until the host connection closes; unused services never start during runtime discovery. Closing the connection ends worker input. Separately accepted native jobs retain their existing ownership policy.
security_controls.on_violation: Close the transport on input closure or termination; do not introduce an update-protection companion or retained full-package snapshot.

security_controls.control: The shared entry supplies the same local Archive session identifier to every lazily started service in this connection. It retains an explicitly supplied session or host chat identity; otherwise it generates a new identifier for this connection only. The identifier is local routing metadata, not an inferred conversation identity. Separate connections without a host identity receive distinct identifiers. Existing Archive session checks and explicit permanent-default selection remain unchanged.
security_controls.on_violation: Keep the existing Archive ownership checks; do not adopt another connection's temporary root or replace the permanent default.

security_controls.control: The local Archive wrapper serves the same runtime in chat and panel-only modes. The panel returns client/practice labels, stable IDs and registration/status fields only in app-only _meta.archive; model-visible tool content is a generic status. Private identities, source documents and raw worker errors are not projected. The HTML uses local embedded fonts, no external resources, and textContent for stored labels. Only an explicit new-chat button sends the selected stable client and optional engagement IDs with a fixed user request through the host ui/message capability. No document content is read or sent by browsing. The host may expose UI through separately authorized screen or DOM inspection; app-only metadata is not a promise of host-wide invisibility. Backend failures render a retryable error without marking the opening tool as an unusable app.
security_controls.on_violation: Return a generic panel error without private worker paths or source contents; preserve archive settings and records.

access.arrangement: The selected host and its authorized local OS account. This transport adds no account or external recipient.

data_returned.content: Existing tool schemas, resource descriptions and prompt definitions, followed by the unchanged selected service response. Requested professional content may enter the selected host model context under the existing workflow contract.

retention.statement: Routing maps, pending requests and child handles live in entry-process memory. The transport adds no case log or persistent output. Existing services retain their existing saved work and technical receipts.

service_details.trigger: The host opens one local entry process per product connection; only explicit tool, prompt or resource use starts its owner. Package builds query discovery in temporary storage with incident delivery disabled.
